title: Sources: Anthropic is aiming to go public the week of November 16 and could raise ~$100B at a $1.5T to $2T valuation, after initially preparing for October (Wall Street Journal)
commentary: $2T valuation for a company still burning cash at scale — Anthropic's S-1 is essentially an argument that safety-first AI is worth more than most sovereign wealth funds, and investors have three weeks to decide if they believe it.
